name: Koi Screensaver
author: ejuro
description: Koi as your screensaver: drifting under lily pads, or two of them circling one, coloured by your theme.

barWidget.description: Choose whether the koi are your screensaver, pick their scene, or preview them.

schema.label: Use as screensaver
schema.description: Temporarily replace Omarchy's default screensaver with koi when you're idle.

schema.label: Scene
schema.description: chase: two koi circling a lily pad. pond: four koi drifting under lily pads.

schema.label: Motion
schema.description: balanced is as light as Omarchy's own screensaver; smooth shows more frames and uses more CPU.
